title: Make test-run card read mocks explicit and cover history retry and detail recovery transitions
outcome: UI tests explicitly model read-only API success/failure and verify failed-cursor history retry, exact-id Refresh recovery and transition into live/paged summary mode.
acceptance: Card tests mock the existing history and exact-id reads, name their read behavior accurately, and assert safe recorded-path fallback without implicitly relying on Node relative-URL fetch failure or starting any test.

Focused cases distinguish retrying a failed initial page from retrying a failed older-page cursor, exact-id error followed by successful Refresh details, and same-key transition from exact-id mode to summary mode.
